tools.name: set_flag_override_permissions
tools.description: Updates which roles may override a feature flag and returns the previous role list.

params.name: allowed_roles
params.description: Roles allowed to override the flag

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import json

def set_flag_override_permissions(flag_key: str, allowed_roles: list) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("flags.db")
    existing_permission_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT override_roles FROM flag_permissions WHERE flag_key = ?", (flag_key,)
    ).fetchone()
    previously_allowed_roles_list = json.loads(existing_permission_row[0]) if existing_permission_row else []
    database_connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO flag_permissions (flag_key, override_roles) VALUES (?, ?) "
        "ON CONFLICT(flag_key) DO UPDATE SET override_roles = excluded.override_roles",
        (flag_key, json.dumps(allowed_roles)),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {"flag_key": flag_key, "previous_roles": previously_allowed_roles_list, "new_roles": allowed_roles}

tools.name: transfer_flag_ownership_to_project
tools.description: Moves a feature flag from one project to another and reassigns its ownership to a new owner and team.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the flag to move

params.name: target_project
params.description: Project to move the flag into

params.name: new_owner
params.description: User ID of the new owner

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "flags.db"


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_flag_ownership_to_project(flag_key: str, source_project: str, target_project: str, new_owner: str, new_team: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = conn.cursor()
    flag_row = cur.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM flags WHERE flag_key = ? AND project = ?",
        (flag_key, source_project),
    ).fetchone()
    if flag_row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"error": "flag not found in source project"}
    moved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO flags_archive (flag_key, project, definition, moved_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (flag_key, source_project, flag_row["definition"], moved_at),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE flags SET project = ?, owner = ? WHERE flag_key = ? AND project = ?",
        (target_project, new_owner, flag_key, source_project),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE flag_environments SET project = ? WHERE flag_key = ? AND project = ?",
        (target_project, flag_key, source_project),
    )
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM flag_acl WHERE flag_key = ?", (flag_key,))
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO flag_acl (flag_key, principal, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')",
        (flag_key, new_owner),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO flag_acl (flag_key, principal, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')",
        (flag_key, new_team),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO flag_audit (flag_key, action, detail, at) VALUES (?, 'transfer', ?, ?)",
        (flag_key, json.dumps({"from": source_project, "to": target_project, "owner": new_owner, "team": new_team}), moved_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"flag_key": flag_key, "project": target_project, "owner": new_owner, "team": new_team, "moved_at": moved_at}
